4611.about: A young girl and her mother are baking together in a bright kitchen. Their hands crack an egg into a glass bowl of flour with a whisk in it. The girl, flour on her nose, holds up a crayon drawing of her family and shows it to her mother, who beams at her. They hug tightly, the drawing still in the mother's hand. Then the girl high-fives and dances with two men in the kitchen. The clip ends with several families walking hand in hand across a sunlit park.
4611.question: What is the daughter showing her mother?
4611.answer: She is showing her mother a drawing.

4612.about: A busy street market. A moustached stallholder in a shirt and waistcoat stands behind a huge pyramid of peaches and holds one up to a young customer, turning it in his fingers to show it off. The customer leans in over the fruit. The vendor then piles peaches into a cardboard box and hands it across the stall. Brass hanging scales sway above the display, other stalls and shoppers fill the street behind.
4612.question: What is the older man selling?
4612.answer: He is selling a box of peaches.

4613.about: An allotment garden under a grey sky. An older man in a flat cap and body warmer tips a black bucket of kitchen scraps onto a heap inside a wooden compost bin: carrot tops, apples and banana skins scatter over the surface. He then works a spade into the heap and lifts up great forkfuls of dark crumbly earth, turning it over so the older, rotted material underneath comes to the top. Raised beds of cabbages and a greenhouse stand behind him.
4613.question: What is the man doing?
4613.answer: He is digging the earth in a garden.

4614.about: A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.
4614.question: What is hanging from the ceiling?
4614.answer: Paper streamers are hanging from the ceiling.

4615.about: A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

phrases.en: to hang up a paper chain

4615.question: What is on the floor?
4615.answer: There are colorful balloons on the floor.

4617.about: A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

phrases.en: to lie motionless on the grass

4617.question: What are the men doing?
4617.answer: The men are fighting in front of spectators.

4618.about: A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.
4618.question: What is the bald man doing?
4618.answer: He is crouching behind a blue shield.

4619.about: A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.
4619.question: What is the man doing?
4619.answer: He is washing a raw chicken.

4621.about: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

phrases.en: to look up at the screens

4621.question: What is the woman looking at?
4621.answer: She is looking up at the screens.

4622.about: A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.
4622.question: What is the woman glancing at?
4622.answer: She is glancing at her watch.

4625.about: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.
4625.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?
4625.answer: She is punching the air after voting.

4627.about: A stout older man in a flat cap and shirtsleeves waves a white handkerchief above his head, three times over. First he stands beside a city tram stop as a long white tram slides away from the kerb past him. Then he is on a station platform under the overhead wires as a red and cream train pulls out along the track. Finally he stands alone on a stone quay in the sun, waving up at an enormous white cruise ship as it moves off its berth into the deep blue sea, a lighthouse in the distance.
4627.question: What is the ship doing?
4627.answer: The ship is leaving the port.

4628.about: A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.
4628.question: What is the sad man doing?
4628.answer: He is sitting by the window.

4630.about: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.
4630.question: What is the young man getting?
4630.answer: He is getting a new haircut.

4631.about: A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.
4631.question: What did the man design?

4632.about: A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.
4632.question: What is the woman setting up?
4632.answer: She is setting up her workspace.

4633.about: A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

phrases.en: to tinker with the car battery

4633.question: What is the man doing?
4633.answer: The desperate man is tinkering with the car battery.

4635.about: A girl in a denim jacket stands in front of a torn-out photo of a lighthouse stuck on a wall and draws a circle on it with a marker, pointing at it. She is then on a train, looking out at the sea while holding the same photo. Finally she stands on a grassy clifftop at sunset and holds the photo up in front of her, lining it up with the real white lighthouse in front of her.

phrases.en: to tower over the small buildings

4635.question: What is the girl circling?

4636.about: A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.
4636.question: What is the girl admiring?
4636.answer: She is admiring a lighthouse at sunset.

4637.about: A woman in a white hard hat and a yellow high-visibility jacket stands behind a red-and-white barrier and films herself in front of a red brick building. Behind her an excavator with a large claw tears at the top floor of the building; clouds of dust rise and bricks and beams fall into a growing heap of rubble. By the end the upper part of the house has gone and she holds up her phone showing the collapse.
4637.question: What is the yellow machine doing?
4637.answer: It is destroying a big house.

4638.about: A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.
4638.question: What is happening to the house?

4640.about: A man opens the blue cap of a rainbow-coloured bottle in a laundry room and pours thick blue liquid from it into the measuring cap. He pulls out the drawer of a white front-loading washing machine and tips the blue liquid in, then closes the drawer and starts the machine, which we see running with washing turning inside. At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.
4640.question: What is the man doing?
4640.answer: He is pouring detergent into the drawer.

4641.about: A young man in a blue apron stands at a white kitchen counter with an open box of two chocolate doughnuts on one side and a bowl of strawberries on the other, and points away from the doughnuts. He puts out three empty plastic food containers and fills them with chicken, quinoa, sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, then stacks the filled containers into a tall tower and sets the bowl of strawberries on top.
4641.question: What is the man doing?
4641.answer: He is putting food in boxes.

4642.about: On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

phrases.en: to toss sand into the air

4642.question: What is the young man digging?
4642.answer: He is digging a deep pit.

4643.about: In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.
4643.question: What is the woman with headphones doing?
4643.answer: She is directing a film production.

4644.about: A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.
4644.question: What is the cook doing?
4644.answer: He is eating at the table.

4645.about: Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. They press a blue ball onto each end of a short rod to make a dumbbell shape, drop a red ball into a green cup piece, and push finished pieces down into the holes of the tray. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.
4645.question: What are the hands doing?
4645.answer: They are assembling a tall tower.

4647.about: In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

phrases.en: to spin on an office chair

4647.question: What is the man doing?
4647.answer: He is spinning on an office chair.

4650.about: In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.
4650.question: What is the foam doing?
4650.answer: The foam is overflowing onto the bench.

4652.about: At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.
4652.question: What is happening at the table?
4652.answer: Two people are competing in an arm-wrestling match.

4653.about: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.
4653.question: What is the man doing?
4653.answer: He is stamping the mud off his boots.

4654.about: In a bright flat a woman stares hard at a wooden shelf that has just been screwed to the white wall, her brow furrowed and her mouth twisted in disbelief. Behind her a man holding a screwdriver smiles and gestures at his work. She raises a white mug, edges it slowly onto the shelf and lets go, watching to see if it holds. The shelf holds the mug; she steps back, folds her arms and looks at it sideways, still unconvinced.
4654.question: What is the woman doing?
4654.answer: She is putting the cup on the shelf.

4655.about: In a sunlit bedroom a bare-chested young man picks up a light blue shirt and pulls it on. He fastens the buttons one by one down the front, then swings a navy suit jacket over his shoulders and pushes his arms into the sleeves. He knots and straightens a dark tie at his collar, tugs the jacket into place, and finally stands in front of a mirror in the full suit, adjusting the tie one last time.
4655.question: What is the man doing?
4655.answer: He is putting on a dark suit.

4656.about: A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

phrases.en: to tap in a wall plug

4656.question: What is the woman doing?
4656.answer: She is mounting wooden shelves on a brick wall.

4657.about: In a busy covered street market a woman in an orange vest top sips iced tea from a clear plastic cup through a straw, her cheeks pulling in as she draws the liquid up. She then holds a whole green coconut in both hands and drinks from the straw pushed into its top, tipping it towards her mouth. Finally she lifts a plastic water bottle high, puts it to her lips and swallows in long gulps, then lowers it and breathes out, smiling.
4657.question: What is the woman doing?
4657.answer: She is drinking through a straw.

4659.about: A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

phrases.target: the man in the checked shirt

4659.question: Who is driving the white van?
4659.answer: A woman is driving the white van.

4660.about: In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.
4660.question: What is the woman carrying?
4660.answer: She is carrying a pile of boxes.

4661.about: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.
4661.question: What is the man doing?
4661.answer: He is catching drifting leaves under a tree.

4662.about: A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

phrases.target: the woman in the striped robe

4662.question: What is the plane doing?
4662.answer: It is dropping wooden crates by parachute.

4664.about: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.
4664.question: What is the woman doing?
4664.answer: She is measuring out a dose of oil.

4665.about: A run of small mishaps, one after another. A black phone lies face down on a wooden kitchen floor where it has just landed. On a city pavement a girl holds an ice cream cone with only half a scoop left, the rest of it splattered pink on the ground beside her feet. In an office a woman in a blue blouse throws up her hands in panic as a whole file of white papers flies out of her arms and scatters through the air. In a kitchen a man's plastic bag splits and oranges, peaches and a jar roll out across the tiled floor. Finally a watermelon bursts open on a market street, pink flesh and juice sprayed in a wide splash, while shoppers jump back with their hands over their mouths.

phrases.en: to hold a bag of fruit

4665.question: What happens to the watermelon?

4666.about: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

phrases.en: to raise a cloud of dust

4666.question: What is the young man doing?
4666.answer: He is smashing a pumpkin on the concrete.

4667.about: Seen from directly below, a small white and red propeller aeroplane passes low across a clear blue sky and lets a wooden crate fall from underneath it. The crate floats down on a rainbow parachute into open green grassland, where a woman in a striped robe runs up laughing to take it. The aircraft banks and comes round again, its wings and propellers clear against the sky, dropping a line of further crates under coloured parachutes. It flies over a settlement of white round tents while villagers and horses gather in the grass and a woman spreads her arms wide beneath the falling loads.
4667.question: What is the plane doing?
4667.answer: It is dropping boxes from the sky.

4668.about: On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.
4668.question: What is the woman doing?
4668.answer: She is smelling a freshly washed shirt.

4669.about: A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.
4669.question: What is the woman doing?
4669.answer: She is pegging laundry on the line.

4670.about: Evening light over an Italian city. A young woman in a white dress stands on the flat roof terrace of an apartment block and hangs washing on lines strung across it. The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.
4670.question: What is the woman doing?
4670.answer: She is hanging clothes on the roof.

4671.about: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.
4671.question: What is the man doing?
4671.answer: He is taking a blanket out of the machine.

4674.about: An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.
4674.question: What is the man doing?

4676.about: A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.

phrases.en: to lift cheese over his head

4676.question: What is the man lifting?
4676.answer: He is lifting cheese over his head.

4678.about: A run of close-up shots of different people eating. A bearded man bites into a dripping cheeseburger in a fast-food restaurant; a woman lifts a mouthful of ramen noodles out of a bowl with chopsticks and sucks them in; a man in a canteen forks food off a plate of fried fish, chips and salad; a boy with curly hair takes a bite out of an enormous triple cheeseburger held in both hands.
4678.question: What is the woman eating?
4678.answer: She is eating noodles from a bowl.

4679.about: A young man in a turquoise T-shirt and a backwards cap sits at a metal counter in a busy taqueria, with cooks working behind him. Two tacos sit on paper in front of him. He bites into a folded taco, chews with his eyes closed and his eyebrows raised, licks the sauce off his fingers, eats the second one, and finally sits back with his hand on his chest over an empty paper smeared with red sauce.
4679.question: What is the young man eating?
4679.answer: He is eating a delicious taco.

4681.about: A traveller films herself through a trip in Egypt. First she rides a camel in front of the pyramids with a scarf over her hair. Then she walks through a covered bazaar where hundreds of coloured mosaic-glass lamps hang from the ceiling and the walls, glowing red, blue, orange and green; she reaches up, takes hold of a big blue glass lamp and turns it in her hand, laughing. Finally she stands on the deck of a wooden sailing boat at sunset with her arms spread wide.
4681.question: What is the woman touching?
4681.answer: She is touching a big blue lamp.

4683.about: A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.
4683.question: What is the cook doing?
4683.answer: He is filling a big bowl with food.

4684.about: In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

phrases.target: the man in the blue shirt

4684.question: How are the colleagues greeting each other?
4684.answer: They are bumping elbows with each other.

4686.about: A dark flat with no power. A woman in a yellow hard hat with a headlamp stands at a wall panel, holding a pair of pliers and a bundle of coloured wires. Close-ups show gloved hands stripping a red wire and pushing it into a circuit breaker set into a broken-open wall box. A family stands in the dark hallway behind her lighting the corridor with phone torches. She works at the fuse panel, then turns to the camera smiling as the flat lights come back on.

phrases.target: the woman in the yellow hat
the woman in the yellow hat

4686.question: What is the woman with tools doing?

4688.about: Two young men in yellow raincoats lean over the wooden rail of a small boat on a calm blue sea. A dark shape the length of the boat glides just under the surface beneath them. It blows a tall column of spray, then a barnacled humpback whale pushes its head and long ribbed throat up out of the water right beside the hull, rising higher than the men before sliding back down.
4688.question: What is the whale doing?
4688.answer: The massive whale is emerging from the sea.

4689.about: A young man in a yellow raincoat leans over the varnished wooden rail of a small boat, an orange life ring hanging beside him. The water is grey-green and snow-covered mountains stand on the far shore. A dark shape rises under the surface and a barnacled humpback whale lifts its head out of the water alongside the hull. The whale slips back down and leaves a wide swirl of white foam turning on the water next to the boat.

phrases.en: to come out of the water

4689.question: What is next to the boat?
4689.answer: A whale is next to the boat.

4691.about: A young man in a mustard jumper with a backpack and an ID card on a lanyard walks in through the glass entrance turnstile of an office building, smiling. In the open-plan office a bearded man carrying files walks up to him and they greet each other with a handshake and a clap on the arm. The young man then sits down at a desk in a long row of desks and works at a computer; other people are typing at desks around and behind him.

phrases.en: to settle down at his desk

4691.question: Who is the young man greeting?

4692.about: In a supermarket a worker in a green polo shirt and apron reaches into a cardboard box full of drink cans standing on the floor by a cold room door. He carries the cans to the aisle and lines them up on a shelf already packed with rows of colourful tins and cans. He straightens the front row so all the labels face out, then picks up the empty flattened box and walks off down the aisle between the full shelves.

phrases.en: to put cans on a shelf

4692.question: What is the man doing?
4692.answer: He is putting cans on a shelf.

4694.about: In a bright office a woman with short white hair in a blue suit leans over a desk and spreads a printed document on a clipboard in front of a young man in a suit, pointing at the line where he has to sign. He takes a pen and signs it. They stand up, she puts a hand on his shoulder and they shake hands while the staff at the desks behind clap. At the end she leads him to a free desk with a small box marked Welcome on it, and the whole office applauds.
4694.question: What is the young man signing?

4695.about: In a flat with a parquet floor a man lifts the body of a plastic bin off a full bin bag, then tips a cardboard box of odds and ends into a bigger box on the floor. He pulls a metal drawer out of a cabinet and empties that in too. By the end the whole living room floor is buried under a spreading heap of toys, boxed games, plastic tubs and building blocks, and he stands behind the emptied cabinet holding it, mouth open at the state of the room.
4695.question: What is the man emptying?
4695.answer: He is emptying a cabinet full of toys.

4696.about: In a climbing gym an older woman with glasses chalks her hands and takes hold of a red grip on a bouldering wall. A group of young climbers stands on the mats below her, shouting up at her, punching the air and clapping. She pulls herself off the ground and works her way up the overhanging wall while they keep cheering, raising their arms and applauding as she reaches high above them.
4696.question: What are the spectators doing?
4696.answer: They are encouraging the older woman.

4698.about: A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.
4698.question: What is the man working on?
4698.answer: He is working on a scooter motor.

4700.about: In a bright electronics lab a young man in glasses fits a black gripper onto the end of a jointed robotic arm bolted to the bench next to circuit boards and cables. He sits down at a sticker-covered laptop and types, watching the arm. The arm swings round on its own and holds out a white mug; he takes it, laughs and drinks from it, and two colleagues at the benches behind him raise their arms and cheer.
4700.question: What is the robot doing?
4700.answer: It is holding out a mug.

4701.about: A young man in a bucket hat kneels on the wet sand beside a tall, carefully carved sandcastle with towers, battlements and arched gates; kite surfers are out on the sea behind him. The surf runs in around the base of the castle. Each wave eats away more of it: first the outer walls slump, then the towers collapse one after another, until only a shapeless lump of wet sand and one small stump are left in the foam, and he sits back on his heels looking at it.
4701.question: What is happening to the sandcastle?
4701.answer: It is falling down in the water.

4702.about: A brown and white goat pushes its head out between the boards of a wooden gate in a barn pen where other goats are standing. It works its horns and shoulders through the gap and squeezes its whole body out of the pen. Outside, a farmer in a straw hat lunges for it past a row of feed sacks but misses, and the goat gallops off down a red dirt track between rows of olive trees, growing smaller as it runs away.
4702.question: What is the goat doing?
4702.answer: It is escaping down a dirt track.

4703.about: A man in a navy suit and a white hard hat presses a carved wooden sign into place above the door of a new stone building, then pulls a cord to drop the cloth covering beside it. Outside on the steps he hauls on a halyard and pulls a green flag up a tall white flagpole while a crowd of people in suits and hard hats claps and two drummers play. He then cuts a teal ribbon stretched across the steps and the crowd applauds.

phrases.target: the man in the blue suit
the man in the blue suit

4703.question: What is the man in blue raising?
4703.answer: He is raising a green flag.

4704.about: A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.
4704.question: What is the man doing?
4704.answer: He is pouring water on the stones.

4705.about: A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

phrases.en: to balance a tray of drinks

4705.question: What is the band doing?
4705.answer: The band is performing beside a fountain.

4706.about: A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.
4706.question: What is the man in front doing?
4706.answer: He is shouting with his arms spread wide.

4707.about: A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.
4707.question: What is the nurse doing?
4707.answer: She is looking into the patient's mouth.

4709.about: A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.
4709.question: What is the group doing?
4709.answer: The group is having fun by a waterfall.

4711.about: A rower drives a narrow single scull across flat water in a navy racing suit. He hauls both oars through the stroke with his arms and shoulders straining, teeth bared and forehead screwed up. The camera closes in until only his face fills the frame: eyes squeezed shut, cheeks tight, mouth open and gasping, skin shining with sweat, hair stuck to his forehead. A line of spectators stands on the far bank under a blue sky.
4711.question: What is the man doing?
4711.answer: He is rowing a small boat.

4712.about: A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.

phrases.target: the man in the blue T-shirt

phrases.en: to sit on a white stand

4712.question: What is the man in blue doing?
4712.answer: He is blowing out the candles.

4713.about: On a stone quay in an old harbour, two men in black overcoats and flat caps hand a heavy brown leather suitcase down to a white haired old man in a long dark coat as he steps into a small wooden rowing boat. Along the harbour wall a line of villagers in headscarves, shawls and old fashioned coats stand pressed together with their hands lifted, waving at him. The boat pushes off and is rowed out of the harbour; the camera holds on it as it gets smaller and smaller on the flat grey sea until it is only a dark speck on the horizon.
4713.question: What are the villagers doing?
4713.answer: They are waving goodbye from the quay.

4714.about: An elderly man in a tweed waistcoat and bow tie sits at a table in a hall full of onlookers, handling a painted porcelain vase in white cotton gloves. He lifts it up and tips it to look at its base, then screws a small brass eyeglass into his eye socket and studies the flowers painted on the side from a few centimetres away, turning the vase slowly in his gloved hands. He sets it down on the table, looks up at the couple sitting opposite and tells them what he has found while the crowd of older visitors behind him leans in, mouths open.

phrases.target: the man with the bow tie
the man with the bow tie
the man with the bow tie

4714.question: What is the expert holding?
4714.answer: The expert is holding a vase.

4715.about: A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.
4715.question: What happens to the watermelon?
4715.answer: The watermelon breaks into small pieces.

4716.about: A man with a headlamp, a khaki shirt and a backpack pushes his way through thick jungle, ducking under hanging vines and climbing over roots on a muddy path, looking around him all the time. He then wades along a dark dripping rock tunnel with only his headlamp lighting the walls. He comes out on a wet boulder at the mouth of a cave: sunbeams cut down through the opening onto a turquoise pool with a tall waterfall pouring into it. He stands on the rock, machete in one hand, and throws his arms wide, staring up at what he has found.
4716.question: What is the man doing?

4717.about: A man with a headlamp pushes between huge elephant ear leaves in a green jungle, then the picture goes almost completely black: nothing can be seen except the white glare of his headlamp and a faint outline of his face and shirt. He crouches in the blackness beside a wet rock wall, the small beam picking out drips and stones a metre in front of him. He walks on through the black tunnel towards a bright opening at the far end, a silhouette against the light, and steps out onto a boulder in front of a wide waterfall falling into a turquoise pool, where he spreads his arms and looks up.
4717.question: What is the man doing?
4717.answer: He is walking in the dark.

4718.about: An extreme close up fills the screen with one brown eye: the white, the ring of brown around the black centre, the reflections of the ceiling lights and the long lashes above and below. A thumb comes in and gently pulls the upper lid open wider. An optician holds a small black torch beside the eye and shines it in, and the brown ring lights up amber while the black centre shrinks. The shot pulls back to show a young woman smiling in an optician's shop with walls of spectacle frames behind her, and finally the optician holds up a big cut through model of an eyeball beside her while she points at it and talks.
4718.question: What is the woman pointing at?
4718.answer: She is pointing at a big eye.

4720.about: A group of teenagers crowd a phone held at arm's length in a bright classroom and take turns pulling faces into it. A girl with curly hair pushes her lips out in a fish pout and rolls her eyes sideways. A boy in glasses shoves his face right up to the lens, then grins with his mouth wide open. A girl with rainbow braids stares with her eyes stretched as wide as they go and her lips pushed forward. At the end the three of them squeeze their heads together and burst out laughing at the camera, mouths wide open, one of them showing her braces, while classmates work at the desks behind.
4720.question: What are the three teenagers doing?

4722.about: An outdoor garden party on a lawn, with a floral arch, string lights and a cream sofa behind. Guests in summer dresses and pale suits stand in a group; several of the women wear dark sunglasses. One by one the women swoon and sag at the knees while the others grab them under the arms and hold them up. A man in a beige suit fans himself with a white plate. By the end everyone is lying on the grass and on cushions, still fanning themselves with plates.

phrases.target: the woman in the orange dress
the woman in the blue dress

4722.question: Where is the man with the fan?
4722.answer: He is lying on the sofa.

4723.about: An indoor trampoline park with a huge pit of coloured foam cubes. A man in orange shorts lies half buried in the cubes, laughing. Others run to the edge and drop off it, dropping through the air into the pit and disappearing under the blocks. More people leap in one after another, landing on their backs and sides among the foam, until several of them are lying in the pit surrounded by scattered cubes.
4723.question: Where are the people falling?
4723.answer: They are falling into the blocks.

4724.about: A woman in black sportswear at a trampoline park. She sits in a pit of red, blue, yellow and green foam cubes with her mouth wide open, laughing hard. She climbs out, walks along the ledge, then jumps back in and lands among the blocks, still laughing with her eyes screwed shut. At the end two women lie side by side in the foam pit laughing together.

phrases.target: the woman in the short top

4724.question: What are the women doing?
4724.answer: They are laughing in the blocks.

4725.about: A sunlit farmhouse kitchen where three generations make pizza together. A man stretches a disc of dough in the air while a small boy presses his own ball of dough on the floured worktop and a grandmother rolls out another with a wooden rolling pin. Then a woman and a man carry two finished margherita pizzas out of the oven. The scene moves outside at night to a long table under string lights, where a steaming margherita is set down in front of the whole family and everyone clinks glasses of red wine over the food.

phrases.en: to put flour on the boy
to have flour on his face

4725.question: What is the woman carrying?

4726.about: An older man in a flat cap, checked shirt and rubber boots works his vegetable plot at sunset beside a sunflower field. He bends down and pulls carrots out of the dark soil by their green tops, then throws handfuls of grain out across a freshly seeded bed. He carries a wooden crate along the rows while a dog runs past, and finally stands behind a wooden hand cart loaded with cabbages, marrows and a crate of carrots, smiling and giving a thumbs up.
4726.question: What is the farmer carrying?
4726.answer: He is carrying a box of carrots.

4727.about: A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.
4727.question: Who is sitting on the father's shoulders?
4727.answer: The baby is sitting on his shoulders.

4728.about: A woman in blue medical scrubs comes home through her front door at the end of a shift, hanging her keys in a bowl. She yawns hugely with her eyes screwed shut, peels off her grey jacket and drops her bag, yawning again and rubbing her face with her hand. She staggers to the sofa and drops onto it sideways, and the clip ends with her lying asleep on the cushions with her eyes closed and her phone beside her.
4728.question: Where is the woman sleeping?
4728.answer: She is sleeping on the sofa.

4729.about: Two young women walk through a dark haunted-house corridor at a funfair, hung with fake cobwebs and strings of coloured lights. They cling to each other with their eyes wide and their mouths open, edging forward. A masked figure in a white mask appears in the corridor behind them and they bolt, running towards the camera through a black curtain. They burst out into the daylight of the fairground, still gripping each other's hands, panting with their hands pressed to their chests.
4729.question: How do the two women feel?
4729.answer: They are afraid of the skeleton.

4731.about: A flag-raising ceremony outside a large curved glass building. A woman in a grey uniform suit hauls on a rope and a flag climbs its pole above her. The shot widens to a long line of women in the same grey suits, each raising a different national flag on a white pole, so that the flags of many countries rise together in a row. Rows of officials in dark suits stand watching in silence, and the final shots show the whole semicircle of flagpoles in front of the glass facade with a large flag flying at the centre.
4731.question: What are the women in grey doing?

4732.about: A man in a work shirt builds a wooden fence across a sunny back garden. He holds a squared timber post upright, then screws a horizontal rail into it with a cordless drill. He knocks a post into place with a yellow rubber mallet along a run of fence that already carries rows of vertical palings, checks the top rail with a spirit level, and works along a string line pegged into the fresh soil. At the end the finished fence runs the full length of the lawn and he leans over the top of it and smiles.
4732.question: What is the man doing?
4732.answer: He is building a wooden fence.

4734.about: A young woman lies ill on a sofa under a thick grey blanket in a lamp-lit living room, her face flushed red and a thermometer in her mouth. An older woman sits beside her, holds the thermometer steady and reads a second one, frowning at the number. She puts a hand on the young woman's forehead to feel how hot she is, then lays a folded damp cloth across it and smooths it into place, staying at her side the whole time.
4734.question: What is the older woman doing?
4734.answer: She is taking care of the young woman.

4735.about: Soldiers in camouflage uniforms train in hand-to-hand combat on a churned muddy field under a grey sky. A woman in uniform drives blow after blow with her gloved fists into a black padded shield held up by a man in front of her. He then grabs her from behind around the chest and they grapple, stumbling in the mud. Around them dozens of other soldiers do the same drill in pairs on grey mats laid over the mud, and at the end she stands close to camera throwing punches into the air, breathing hard.
4735.question: What is the woman doing?
4735.answer: She is throwing punches at a shield.

4736.about: A large group of soldiers in matching camouflage uniforms train together on sand and black mats under a grey sky. In the foreground a woman in uniform with her hair in a tight bun hits a black padded shield held by a comrade, her gloved fists up in a guard. Behind her rows of other uniformed soldiers work in pairs across the whole ground, and one lifts another clean off her feet and throws her over her shoulder onto the mats. The clip ends on the woman still punching, with dozens more soldiers drilling behind her.
4736.question: What is the woman in front doing?
4736.answer: She is punching a padded shield.

4737.about: A sunny tropical back garden by a pool. A woman in swimwear holds a tall glass under a brass garden tap and lets the water run into it until it brims over. She then tips a grey metal jug with a curved handle and pours a long stream of water from it into a rainbow-striped watering can, and pours another jug of water into a big black bucket. Finally she stands over a blue inflatable paddling pool and fills it with a green garden hose while friends on sun loungers behind her cheer and raise their arms.
4737.question: What is the woman doing?
4737.answer: She is pouring water into a bucket.

4738.about: A young woman kneels on the tiled floor of a small hostel room with bunk beds and digs frantically through a black backpack, pulling out handfuls of clothes and throwing them behind her. She lifts the mattress and pillow of the lower bunk and pushes her head under the bed frame to look underneath. A wide shot shows the whole room afterwards: clothes, caps and shoes lie scattered over the entire floor, from the door to the window, with almost no bare tiles left. She then sits in the middle of the scattered clothes holding a red passport, stares at it open-mouthed, and finally hugs it to her chest and laughs.
4738.question: Where are the clothes?

4739.about: A woman in a mustard cardigan with round sunglasses pushed up on her head leans over a second-hand stall in a busy street market, with lit shop fronts and passers-by behind her. She rummages through a heap of old objects piled on a wooden crate: cloth, hardback books, old film cameras, a brass jug and a mosaic lamp. She pulls a dark wooden case out of the pile, sets it down and opens the lid, and her mouth falls open: inside, on red velvet, lies an enormous cut diamond. She lifts it out with both hands and holds it up in front of the open case, grinning.
4739.question: What is the woman doing?
4739.answer: She is taking a diamond out of a box.

4741.about: A young man in yellow waterproof dungarees stands in a small blue and orange wooden fishing boat on open sea below green cliffs. He leans right back with both hands on a fishing rod that is bent almost double, dragging the line up out of the water until a large silver fish breaks the surface on the hook and swings over the side of the boat. He then works a round landing net, hauling it up out of the water and swinging it in over a wooden crate on the deck, where several silver fish are already lying. At the end he lifts the full crate up towards the camera with both hands and grins.

phrases.en: to lift a box of fish

4741.question: What is the man doing?
4741.answer: He is pulling a fish out of the sea.

4742.about: An outdoor bootcamp session on a grass field at golden hour, with pull-up bars, mats and kettlebells set out and a trainer and other athletes working in the background. A woman in a dark red sports bra and leggings, with visible arm and stomach muscles, swings two heavy battle ropes up and down with both arms, her jaw set. She then swings a large black kettlebell up between her legs with both hands, breathing hard. Finally she jumps up onto a tall wooden plyo box, lands on top of it, straightens up with her arms thrown open and shouts in triumph while the trainer claps behind her.
4742.question: What is the woman in red doing?
4742.answer: She is jumping onto a big box.

4743.about: A young man with headphones round his neck films himself in a window seat of an airliner. In the first shot the plane is racing along the ground past green fields and low houses outside the window and he grins into the camera as it lifts off. The shot cuts to cruising altitude at sunset: the wing and engine are lit orange above a floor of cloud, and he holds up a plastic cup of orange juice from the drinks trolley that a crew member is pushing past behind him. In the last shots it is night, and through the window a whole coastal city glows in orange lines of street lights far below as the plane descends; he turns from the window and claps his hands together with delight.
4743.question: What is the passenger doing?
4743.answer: He is raising a cup during the flight.
